hardware: AWS m7g.4xlarge (Graviton3, 16 cores / 64 GB). Gateway-under-test pinned to 4 cores (the comparable basis); mock and load generator on 6 cores each so the mock never bottlenecks the streaming sweep. Ubuntu 24.04. One dedicated box per gateway.

files.litellm-python.txt:
# ── config.gen.yaml (rendered; loaded via --config /config.gen.yaml) ──
model_list:
  - model_name: gpt-4o-mini
    litellm_params:
      model: openai/gpt-4o-mini
      api_base: http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1
      api_key: dummy

# ── launch argv (non-secret; provider api keys above are dummy on the isolated rig) ──
litellm --config /config.gen.yaml --port 8102 --telemetry False

matrix.upstream_note: v2: full 6x6. Top-level cells are the openai-egress row for v1 compatibility; the full grid is under upstreams.<egress>.cells keyed by ingress dialect.
matrix.egress_configured: openai openai-responses anthropic gemini cohere bedrock
matrix.capability_note: advisory context only (probe-first: every cell is probed regardless): LiteLLM accepts OpenAI ingress into any provider plus native Anthropic/Responses ingress diagonals; other ingress rows are grey by declaration

memory.protocol: post-6x6, fresh cold restart: 60s COLD idle (measured before the process serves any request) -> fixed load on the peak cell (c=64, payload=4096B, 120s, identical on every gateway) -> 60s recovery
